d: The Philadelphia 76ers opened the season with a 106-100 victory over the New York Knicks. Tyrese Maxey led Philadelphia with 28 points, four rebounds, five assists, three steals, and three blocks, while Jaylen Brown added 19 points, eight rebounds, and six assists. LeBron James contributed 14 points, nine rebounds, and seven assists. Jalen Brunson paced New York with 21 points, five rebounds, and three assists, while Karl-Anthony Towns recorded 19 points and 12 rebounds. Josh Hart added 14 points and seven rebounds in the loss.
